cases.explain: «Хорошая жена» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

cases.explain: «гибельная засада» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

cases.explain: «Честный свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

cases.explain: «Умный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
